# zitadel_default_notification_policy (Resource)

Resource representing the default notification policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zitadel_default_notification_policy" "default" {
  password_change = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password_change` (Boolean) Send notification if a user changes his password

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

```bash
# Terraform rejects empty import IDs, so the resource is imported with the placeholder id
# `default`, which ZITADEL ignores, e.g.
terraform import zitadel_default_notification_policy.imported 'default'
```
